name: Shadowgrange Archfiend
clause: When ~ enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control. You gain life equal to the greatest power among creatures sacrificed this way.

needs.semantics: Four independent holes this batch hit: 'As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters' (Skrelv's Hive), 'If X is 5 or more' (White Sun's Twilight), 'If it's the first combat phase of your turn' (Tifa), and 'sacrifice all creatures you control' / 'a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control' (Emrakul, Shadowgrange Archfiend).
needs.clause: As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control with toxic have lifelink.
